investigations.evidenceSummary: Fresh pass identifies ladecloud as a relevant RhönEnergie charging backend and current AFIR/e-clearing tariff evidence. Public BNetzA-derived inventory at 2026-09-01 reports 279 charging installations / 556 charge points, of which 538 are below 50 kW and 18 are DC >=50 kW, so the former ~300-point denominator is stale. Mobilithek/e-clearing reporting integrated in 2026 exposes RhönEnergie-dominated direct/ad-hoc prices of 0.51 EUR/kWh AC and 0.61 EUR/kWh DC plus 1.00 EUR start fee. Current registered RhönEnergie card tariffs show the same 0.51/0.61 preferred-network energy rates for Gelegenheits-Lader but registered/contract pricing is not used as anonymous proof. Operator terms indicate unregistered/ad-hoc pricing is surfaced via app/web and can vary by charge point, so the AFIR class values cannot yet be extrapolated blindly to all 556 points.
investigations.coverage: Current operator denominator materially improved: 279 installations / 556 points; AC/DC class profile and AFIR/e-clearing numeric ad-hoc evidence identified; exhaustive EVSE tariff coverage and gross/VAT/blocking semantics not yet closed.
investigations.exactGap: Reconcile all current DE*REF* EVSE against e-clearing/ladecloud/Mobilithek and prove that 0.51 AC / 0.61 DC + 1.00 start applies to every relevant anonymous_ad_hoc EVSE or enumerate exceptions. Close blocking/time fees and explicit gross/VAT semantics for the anonymous flow. Do not use registered Viel-Lader/Gelegenheits-Lader or roaming prices as substitute evidence.
